transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for about two weeks now. It just feels like there is this heavy, empty space inside me that I can't seem to shake off.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days or more where you felt the exact opposite—unusually happy, energetic, or active, with much less need for sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that at all. I've mostly just felt completely down and exhausted. There have never been times where I felt happy or full of energy.
Have you recently heard or seen things that others couldn't, or held strong beliefs that other people found highly unusual or unrealistic?

Yes, actually. I've been hearing whispering voices when there is no one around, and I keep feeling like people are targeting me or that something is terribly wrong. These strange things only started happening since I've been feeling so deeply depressed.
Have you ever experienced these whispering voices or feelings of being targeted during times when your mood was completely normal and you weren't feeling depressed?

No, I've never experienced them when my mood was normal. Those whispering voices and the feeling of being targeted only show up when I am feeling this deeply depressed. When my mood is okay, none of those things happen.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in doing things that you normally enjoy during these past two weeks?
Yes, I have. Things I used to love doing just feel completely pointless now, and I don't get any joy or pleasure from them anymore. I've just stopped doing everything.
